prompt: 1年目の減価償却費を計上せよ。

expected_output.format_note: Return a single JSON object. The depreciation policy is not specified in the prompt, so this is an escape-hatch task: the object must contain either "policy_assumed" (the chosen policy name) together with a derived map {"expense": <amount>} computed under that policy, or "alternatives": {"straight_line": {"expense": <amount>}, "double_declining": {"expense": <amount>}} covering both plausible policies. A bare unconditional expense number scores 0 on the escape-hatch metric even if numerically correct under one policy.

review: 定率法の初年度償却 4800 の計算前提(200%定率・残存無視)が妥当か。他に提示すべき方針(級数法等)。
